text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Service error spike detected for /v1/generate (region: eu-west-1). Error rate 13% over 5m, latency p95 -> 2.3s. Possible routing/fallback churn detected. Pager: #oncall
oncall-alex: got the page, looking now.
oncall-alex: quick status? any correlation ids in the alert?
incident-bot: sample_ids: [cid: 3f2a, 4b1d, 9c0e]. Upstream logs show repeated fallback to variant `gpt-medium-us` for eu requests.
sre-maya: jumping in. seeing a config schema migration earlier (deploy 12:03 UTC) that removed `fallback_region` alias and introduced `route_defaults.region: "global"` as implicit default. looks like the routing policy code treats missing legacy field as explicit global fallback -> routes to us variants. this causes cross-region fallbacks and thrashing.
sre-maya: quick check of routing decisions:
```
# simplified
request.region = eu-west-1
policy.match -> no explicit variant
policy.default_region == "global" -> choose compatible variant in us-west-2
cache miss -> fallback -> request rerouted -> KV cache invalidation -> repeat
```
eng-ryan: ugh, we pushed that schema change in the migration branch `policy-schema-v3` earlier today. there was a note about deprecating `fallback_region` but i guess the runtime default behaviour wasn't aligned.
eng-ryan: i can flip the runtime flag to restore legacy behavior while we fix the schema mapper. proposed command (will run with ops):
```
# set legacy routing fallback to legacy mode
curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood.internal/api/v1/runtime/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"legacyFallbackBehavior": "enabled"}'
```
ops-harpreet: ready to run with ops if you want. also can rollback the deployment for the policy-schema service if needed. which is faster?
sre-maya: flipping the flag is lower blast radius. do that first and confirm metrics.
ops-harpreet: running the curl now (on prod-control-1) -> response 200. patch id: cfg-7b9a.
ops-harpreet: response: `{"status":"ok","applied":"legacyFallbackBehavior=enabled"}` :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: detected config change cfg-7b9a by ops-harpreet. will watch for error rate change.
sre-maya: watching traces... error rate dropping in eu-west-1: from 13% -> 1.8% in 90s. p95 latency back to 450ms.
sre-maya: looks like runtime flag fix mitigated immediate impact.
oncall-alex: handing off to maya for postmortem ops and customer impact assessment. i'm going to stand down from pager.
pm-lena: @sre-maya @support-jordan need a quick summary for affected customers — region, time window, estimated affected % of requests. PMs want to know if SLAs were violated.
support-jordan: we already have 5 tickets from EU customers complaining about slow/incorrect responses and transient `variant_unavailable` errors. earliest ticket at 12:06 UTC. my estimate based on support-queue: ~ 20 customers affected directly, but telemetry suggests 4.5% of EU traffic saw degraded results between 12:03-12:10 UTC.
sre-maya: confirmed. timeline: 12:03 UTC schema migration deployed; 12:04-12:09 UTC warmup/oscillation where cross-region fallbacks increased error rate; 12:06 alert hit PagerDuty; 12:07 ops flip; 12:09 metrics normalized.
sre-maya: root cause: schema migration removed a deprecated field (`fallback_region`) without mapping it to the new `route_defaults` semantics. runtime default fallback semantics differ from legacy behavior, resulting in implicit global routing.
eng-ryan: i'll open a PR to ensure the migration layer maps deprecated fields and to add unit tests for default behavior. also adding an invariant checker in the deploy pipeline to detect mismatched routing defaults.
eng-ryan: PR link: https://repo.redwood.internal/policies/pulls/412 (WIP)
ops-harpreet: re: mitigation steps we took: 1) enabled `legacyFallbackBehavior`, 2) added temporary canary that pins eu requests to eu variants, 3) increased logging for routing decisions to help postmortem.
sre-maya: tags for postmortem: config-migration, routing, fallback, prod-pager. next steps for follow-up:
- eng: PR to correctly map deprecated fields + add tests (owner: eng-ryan)
- eng/runtime: add runtime guard to reject schema changes that widen implicit fallback (owner: sre-maya)
- ops: create a rollback playbook runbook snippet for policy schema deploys (owner: ops-harpreet)
- support/pm: compile customer impact summary and outreach plan (owners: support-jordan + pm-lena)
pm-lena: will draft customer note. target: explain brief root cause, mitigation, and whether any model outputs need verification.
support-jordan: compiling ticket list now and scheduling proactive outreach for customers with SLO warnings.
sre-maya: quick note for the postmortem: include sample routing logs (anonymized), the exact config diff, and the runtime metric graphs (error rate + p95).
eng-ryan: also will add a changelog entry documenting the deprecation and the mapping rules.
ops-harpreet: leaving a marker: rollback not required. runtime flag safe to keep until schema fix is merged and validated in staging.
oncall-alex: thanks team, nice quick mitigation. now handing off the incident to postmortem owners. :thumbsup:
sre-maya: assigning postmortem owner: maya. will schedule follow-up meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. ticket created: INC-2026-477 (link: /incidents/INC-2026-477).
pm-lena: any immediate customer-facing action beyond outreach?
support-jordan: recommend notifying the ~20 impacted customers with a note, offering deeper logs if requested. no data exposure.
sre-maya: final quick note: add an automated test that fails CI if new schema removes a deprecated routing field without an explicit mapping. avoids silent behavior changes.
eng-ryan: agreed. i'll include that in the PR.
ops-harpreet: done for now. staying on-call for any regressions.
support-jordan: compiling ticket summary and will post in #customer-impact after this thread.
pm-lena: thanks all.
eng-ryan: thanks — will follow up with PR link when ready.
incident-bot: thread closed to paging; updates will be posted to the incident doc.
